messages:
sarah: Heads-up — prepping the internal release note for runtime-api rollout tonight. Draft snippet below, can folks confirm pin version and rollback lanes?

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy: runtime-api/2.14.0 -> staging at 2025-11-16T23:30Z. Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 30m. Trigger: manual approve.

alex: Confirmed we need to pin consumer-facing SDK to runtime-api@2.14.0 in the note. Canary will use pool-gpu-2 for the first 10m then spill to pool-gpu-1. No DB migrations.

nina-docs: Draft snippet: "Rice — Runtime API 2.14.0: Latency improvements for streaming and improved KV cache eviction. See ops playbook for canary thresholds and rollback criteria." Posting a slightly longer paragraph in #docs-draft in 5.

mj: Change window reminder — we only have the 2h quiet window tonight. Please keep canary ramp <= 30m and have rollback ready by 00:15Z.

oncall-jordan: Rollback criteria: error rate > 1.5% sustained for 5m OR tail latency P99 > 800ms for 3m. If hit, flip canary off and revert to 2.13.9. I'll be on-call and will coordinate the revert.

ryan-pm: Quick ask — include short customer-facing blurb for comms team? If yes, send final line now so we can queue internal and external.

sarah: Yes — add: "No expected downtime; clients on older SDK will continue to be served by pinned fallback. We recommend customers upgrade to runtime-api@2.14.0 for improved streaming throughput"

alex: Ops note to include in RN: pinned image sha: `sha256:5b7a3d2a` and rollout tags: `canary-5`, `canary-25`, `stable`. Also including deploy command for oncall: ```
# rollback to v2.13.9
kubectl set image deploy/runtime-api runtime-api=runtime-api:2.13.9 -n production
```

nina-docs: I'll fold these into the RN and push the internal announcement draft in #eng-releases in 10. Will tag @channel and add 'who's posting external' placeholder.

ryan-pm: I'll own external comms if ops confirms no blockers during canary.

sarah: Final checklist: 1) docs publish done (nina) 2) canary approval (alex) 3) oncall watch (jordan) 4) external hold (ryan). If everyone replies with :thumbsup: I'll pin and run deploy at scheduled time.

alex: :thumbsup:

oncall-jordan: :thumbsup: I have revert snippet ready.

nina-docs: :thumbsup: draft posted.

ryan-pm: :thumbsup: will standby for go/no-go.

sarah: Thanks — tagging deploy-bot for manual approval when ready.
